messages:
maria: heads-up — our SAST/DAST aggregator (sast-bot) just flagged ephemeral KMS creds in a staging deploy artifact. landing ticket SEC-3245. attaching the minimal log we have below. can someone triage?

sast-bot: [AUTO] Finding ID: FND-2026-9182 | severity: high | rule: 'kms-ephemeral-exposure' | path: builds/staging/2026-03-19-jenkins/artifacts/deploy_meta.json | evidence: \"temp_kms_token\" present in artifact.

jamal: ugh. do we know if the token was actually valid (used to decrypt anything) or just present as a stub?

maria: good q. i grepped the deploy logs — looks like the job emitted creds while calling the 'rotate-and-deploy' helper. snippet: 
```
2026-03-19T15:22:01Z DEBUG rotate-helper: issued ephemeral_kms_token=ya29.xxxx ttl=300
2026-03-19T15:22:02Z INFO deploy: wrote deploy_meta.json to s3://redwood-staging-artifacts/builds/2026-03-19-jenkins/artifacts/
```
no direct decrypt warnings in the same timeframe, but access logs show a GET to that artifact from the build-host 10.8.12.9 at 15:22:05 — likely the same job.

anna: we should treat this as sensitive even if not used. first steps: lock down artifact bucket RBAC so only the CI service account can read, and ensure artifacts expire immediately. also enable S3 object-level AWS CloudTrail data events for GetObject + KMSDecrypt.

dan: agree. also add KMS key usage logs to the central audit index (ELK). if ephemeral token was minted by our helper, we need to verify the helper doesn't print tokens to stdout. that's a code fix in the helper.

jamal: i can patch rotate-helper tonight. quick fix: stop logging the token and redact before writing deploy_meta.json. longer-term: change helper to write token to instance metadata, not artifact.

maria: thanks. can you link a PR here when ready? i'll update SEC-3245.

sre-bot: deploy-1234 (staging) finished with status: SUCCESS :white_check_mark: | artifact retention-days: 7 (currently).

anna: retention-days=7 is too long for anything containing runtime creds. set retention to 0 and enable lifecycle rule to delete artifacts after 1 hour. also restrict bucket putObject so only a signed upload from the CI role is allowed.

jamal: quick policy snippet i plan to apply (will test in staging):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/ci-runner"},"Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging-artifacts/*"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Principal":"*","Action":"s3:GetObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-staging-artifacts/*","Condition":{"Bool":{"aws:SecureTransport":"false"}}}
  ]
}
```
will also add a condition to force encryption with our KMS key.

dan: add the KMS key policy to limit Decrypt to the build role + ops-runbooks role only. and add a CloudWatch alarm on KMS:Decrypt errors > 0 from non-whitelisted principals.

maria: security review: is this a DAST false positive? the artifact is JSON, not running code. the rule flagged presence of token string in artifact which imo is a valid secret finding.

anna: it's a secret exposure; treat as S3/KMS incident. label SEC-3245 as "exposure" and run quick re-eval on other recent artifacts (last 48h). i'll run a bulk grep for "temp_kms_token" and notify owners.

jamal: FYI i'll push a hotfix branch that redacts tokens before upload and rotates the helper to use instance metadata + IMDSv2 for storage. PR will reference SEC-3245 and include unit test to ensure no token is serialized.

maria: can we also add CI linting rule to fail when secrets patterns are serialized into artifacts? maybe add a pre-upload check.

dan: yes — put a pre-upload scanner step that runs the same regex rules as sast-bot. if match -> fail and redact. checklist for action items: 
- jamal: patch rotate-helper (hotfix PR) -> due EOD
- anna: apply S3 lifecycle & enable data events + object-level CloudTrail (config change) -> due today
- dan: add KMS decrypt audit ingestion + CloudWatch alarm -> due tomorrow
- maria: update SEC-3245 incident with findings and owners, run artifact grep (48h) -> in progress

sast-bot: queued re-scan for builds in last 48h. hits will be posted to channel.

jamal: tagging @eng-oncall-anna and @sec-lead-dan for visibility. thanks all. :thumbsup:

maria: i'll create a short blameless postmortem in #postmortems after the triage. closing thread when SEC-3245 is updated with remediation notes.
